data_description.port: Port of the freedo HTTP API (http_listen).
data_description.token: Bearer token of the API. Leave empty when the daemon has no token.

hassio_confirm.title: freedo add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant found the freedo add-on. Set up the integration for it?

error.invalid_auth: The daemon rejects the API token.
error.unknown: The daemon gives an unexpected answer.

init.title: Environment inputs
init.description: Home Assistant sends these states to freedo.

data_description.outdoor_entity: Sent to the daemon on each change and every 15 minutes. It drives the weather curves of the flow limit.
data_description.window_entities: On the next step, you select the zone of each sensor.

windows.title: Zone of each window sensor
windows.description: Select the heating zone of each sensor. A zone is open when one of its sensors is open.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Load it, then open the options again.
abort.no_heating_zone: The installation declares no heating zone.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Starts or stops the boost of a heating zone.

on.name: On
on.description: True starts the boost, false stops it.

set_overlay.name: Set overlay
set_overlay.description: Heats a zone to a temperature or switches it off, and sets when the change ends.

hvac_mode.name: Mode
hvac_mode.description: Heat sets the temperature, off switches the zone off.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature. Required with mode heat, not allowed with mode off.

end_rule.name: End rule
end_rule.description: Manual lasts until the next command, timer lasts for the duration, until next time block lasts until the next block of the weekly program, until next automatic change lasts until the next block of the weekly program or the next switch between home and away, whichever comes first.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of the timer, up to 7 days. Required with end rule timer, not allowed with the other end rules.

set_window.name: Set open window
set_window.description: Activates or resets the open window state of a heating zone. A reset ends the state set from Home Assistant. It does not end a state the valves detected.

open.name: Open
open.description: True activates the open window state, false resets it.

boost_all.name: Boost all zones
boost_all.description: Starts or stops the boost of every heating zone.

on.name: On
on.description: True starts the boost, false stops it.

resume_all.name: Resume all schedules
resume_all.description: Returns every heating zone and the hot water to their weekly schedule.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the weekly schedule of a heating zone or the hot water zone: programs with the days they run on and their time blocks. A zone with no schedule has no programs.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the weekly schedule of a heating zone or the hot water zone. The programs cover each of the seven days once. Each program starts at 00:00 and its times increase.

programs.name: Programs
programs.description: A list of programs. Each has days (mon to sun) and entries. Each entry has time (HH:MM), temperature (5 to 25 C for a heating zone, 30 to 65 C for the hot water zone) and enabled (default true, false switches the zone off).

copy_schedule.name: Copy schedule
copy_schedule.description: Copies the weekly schedule of a zone to other zones of the same kind. A room zone and the hot water zone do not share a schedule.

to.name: Copy to
to.description: The zones that get the schedule.

overlay_temperature_required.message: Set a temperature with mode heat.

overlay_temperature_not_allowed.message: A temperature is not allowed with mode off.

overlay_duration_required.message: Set a duration with end rule timer.

overlay_duration_not_allowed.message: A duration needs end rule timer.

no_schedule.message: The zone {zone} has no schedule to copy.

copy_across_kinds.message: {entity_id} is a different kind of zone. A room zone and the hot water zone do not share a schedule: their temperature ranges differ.

copy_to_itself.message: A zone cannot copy its schedule to itself.
